instructions.content: Verify prerequisites first: aws sts get-caller-identity with the profile, describe-stacks to confirm the stack exists (StackStatus), and make synth to confirm the CDK project synthesises cleanly

Retrieve the deployed template with aws cloudformation get-template --stack-name --region --profile --query TemplateBody --output json into deployed.json, and copy the synthesised template from cdk.out into local.json
Validate both templates as JSON with jq before any comparison
Compare hierarchically, starting with the top-level structure (jq 'keys') of both templates
Compare resource counts with jq '.Resources | length' for both templates
Find added and removed resource IDs by diffing or comm-ing sorted resource key lists with process substitution
Diff the cdk_nag metadata on resources to catch changed CDK Nag suppressions
Diff all resources whose Type starts with AWS::IAM to catch role and policy changes
Categorise each difference by risk (Expected, Low, Medium, High, Critical) before reporting, with a matching action from auto-approve to block
Save artifacts in a timestamped directory named with the branch: deployed.json, local.json, resource lists and comparison-report.md
Write the comparison report with Summary (resource counts and status), Differences, Recommendations and Deployment Decision sections
NEVER compare templates without verifying both sources are valid JSON first
NEVER rely on line-by-line diff for large templates (5000+ lines); use the hierarchical comparison
NEVER approve deployments with unexplained IAM policy changes; extract the IAM diff, document justification and get InfoSec approval
NEVER skip saving comparison artifacts before deployment
Skip template comparison for initial deployments, cross-account comparisons, frequently changing resources, and stacks not created via CDK
Recover from errors: wrong stack name or region for Stack not found, missing env vars in env-local.mk or env.mk for synth failures, --output json with --query TemplateBody for jq parse errors
Block deployment on resource removal and require documented justification plus InfoSec approval for any new CDK Nag suppression
